title: Effect of a Tabulation Action
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols, and let $y$ be a finite Boolean input word. Choose an input-head movement, a write instruction and head movement for each of the $M.k$ work tapes and three auxiliary tapes, an optional output bit, and an optional successor state; also choose a configuration with state, input-head position, tape contents and head positions, and output word. Applying the action formed from these instructions to this configuration yields the configuration with the chosen successor state, input head moved by the clamped input-head movement, each original and auxiliary tape updated at its head exactly when a write is prescribed, each head moved by its prescribed amount, and the optional output bit appended to the output word.
